scientific_status: Potential impact scenario; not calibrated against field-yield ground truth.
severity_source: Semantic lesion mask divided by a documented heuristic leaf mask.

early_blight.citation: Saha, P., & Das, S. (2012). Assessment of Yield Loss Due to Early Blight (Alternaria solani) in Tomato. Indian Journal of Plant Protection, 40(3), 195–198.
early_blight.citation_status: Study reports an absolute slope in t/ha per severity point; it does not validate beta=0.6 as a universal percentage coefficient.

late_blight.citation: Fontem, D. A. (2003). Quantitative Effects of Early and Late Blights on Tomato Yields in Cameroon. Tropicultura, 21(1), 36–41; Nowicki et al. (2012), Plant Disease 96(1), 4–17, doi:10.1094/PDIS-05-11-0458.
late_blight.citation_status: Field evidence supports potentially severe losses but not a universal beta=1.1 mapping.

bacterial_spot.citation: Pohronezny, K., & Volin, R. B. (1983). The effect of bacterial spot on yield and quality of fresh market tomatoes. HortScience, 18(1), 69–70. https://doi.org/10.21273/HORTSCI.18.1.69
bacterial_spot.citation_status: The paper reports yield effects but does not by itself validate beta=0.4 for this dataset.
